'''''Printzina''''' is a [[genus]] of [[green algae]].<ref name="Guiry">Guiry, M.D., John, D.M., Rindi, F. and McCarthy, T.K. (Ed) 2007. ''New Survey of Clare Island''. '''Volume 6''': The Freshwater and Terrestrial Algae. Royal Irish Academy. {{ISBN|978 1 904890 31 7}}</ref> in the family [[Trentepohliaceae]].<ref>See the [[National Center for Biotechnology Information|NCBI]] [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?mode=Info&id=374113 webpage on Printzina].  Data extracted from the {{cite web | url=https://ftp.ncbi.nih.gov/pub/taxonomy/ | title=NCBI taxonomy resources | publisher=[[National Center for Biotechnology Information]] | access-date=2007-03-19}}</ref>

==Species==
''Printzina lagenifera'' (Hildebrandt) Thompson et Wujek.

===Description===
Appears as small, reddish cushion-like masses. Consisting of entangled filaments of globular or elliptical cells 6 - 12μm wide.. It forms reddish streeks.<ref name="Guiry" />
